title: A NEW PASS CANNOT ERASE AN OLD FAIL
semantic_thesis: Admission inside one run answers whether a representation preserved every frozen critical capability in that run. Promotion answers a stronger question: whether independent receipts under the same experimental specification contain any counterexample. A later perfect run is positive evidence, but it cannot delete a conforming historical failure. Under one exact-spec lineage, one preserved counterexample is sufficient to block authoritative promotion until the cause is changed and a new explicitly versioned specification lineage is created.

ru: Новый PASS добавляет свидетельство; он не стирает старый FAIL.
Если один и тот же exact-spec уже породил контрпример, среднее число успешных прогонов не превращает контрпример в отсутствие контрпримеров.
24 из 24 внутри одного запуска — допуск этого запуска, а не автоматическое право стать authoritative runtime.
Зелёный cross-run gate может означать правильный запрет promotion: проверяющий прошёл, кандидат — нет.
Если причина недетерминизма действительно устранена изменением экспериментальной спецификации, начинается новая lineage; старая отрицательная история остаётся сохранённой.
en: A new PASS adds evidence; it does not erase an old FAIL.
Once an exact specification has produced a counterexample, averaging later successful runs does not turn that counterexample into its absence.
Twenty-four of twenty-four inside one run admits that run; it does not automatically confer authoritative-runtime status.
A green cross-run gate may correctly mean promotion was denied: the verifier passed while the candidate did not.
If the cause of nondeterminism is genuinely removed by changing the experimental specification, a new lineage begins while the old negative history remains preserved.

next_semantic_question: Which experimentally controlled change is sufficient to explain and eliminate the Q8_0 cross-run divergence without weakening the frozen critical capability criterion?
boundary: Semantic systems-evaluation interpretation for the frozen eight-sample Round-2.1 critical set. No universal model instability, lossless-quantization theorem, official benchmark accuracy, AGI, consciousness, or independent scientific validation is claimed.
